summary: Arterial kerb by a junction, no parked cars, no pull-off, houses close.
reasons: No verge, junction and crossing nearby
House 11 m away at north end

drivers.seclusion: Grass park and trees to the east, but houses sit at the park edge, 11-15 m from the north end and 21-22 m from the start.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb meets grass with trees and no pull-in; a van would sit in the lane beside a junction.
drivers.traffic: Indooroopilly Road is a through route with steady traffic and turning vehicles.
drivers.convention: No cars parked along this kerb; the only car seen is moving.

flags: Low-lying: about 7 m elevation, Sandy Creek 72 m away
Mapped gate 35 m away with a way round
sun_shade: Large tree to the south-east shades the kerb; otherwise open to the sun.

best_section.where: Indooroopilly Road east kerb, just north of the Harts Road junction
